<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_ComputerRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Computer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Acceptance" name="Acceptance of repair costs"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Computer" name="Bring in defective computer" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Start_CRS" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Accept repair costs" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Customer brings in defective computer">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BringComputer" name="Bring defective computer to CRS" messageRef="Message_Computer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptCosts" name="Are the costs acceptable?" default="Flow_Customer_Reject">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Accept repair costs" messageRef="Message_Acceptance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Accepted" name="Repair accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Rejected" name="Computer taken home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_BringComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Accept" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><![CDATA[accepted]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Reject" name="Not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Task_TakeComputerHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="End_Customer_Accepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_TakeComputerHome" targetRef="End_Customer_Rejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CRS" name="Defective computer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageStartDefinition_Computer" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Repair costs accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageCatchDefinition_Acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOrder" name="Choose repair order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_HardwareFirst</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_SoftwareFirst</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Hardware_First" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_HardwareFirst</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareFirst_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterHardwareFirst" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareFirst_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareFirst_Software</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Software_Second" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareFirst_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareSecond_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareSecond" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareSecond_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareFirst_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Software_First" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_SoftwareFirst</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareFirst" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Hardware_Second" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Hardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareSecond_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterHardwareSecond" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareSecond_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOrderMerge" name="Repair order complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareFirst_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialError" name="Is an error detected?" default="Flow_NoInitialError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InitialError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoInitialError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" name="Choose another repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InitialError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" name="Repair activity complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalTestResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalError" name="Is an error detected?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalTestResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoInitialError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalError</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_1" sourceRef="Start_CRS" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_SendCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_3" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_4" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_HardwareFirst" name="Hardware then software" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOrder" targetRef="Task_Hardware_First"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareFirst_Test" sourceRef="Task_Hardware_First" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterHardwareFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareFirst_Software" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterHardwareFirst" targetRef="Task_Software_Second"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareSecond_Test" sourceRef="Task_Software_Second" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareSecond"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareFirst_Merge" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareSecond" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_SoftwareFirst" name="Software then hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOrder" targetRef="Task_Software_First"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareFirst_Test" sourceRef="Task_Software_First" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareFirst_Hardware" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareFirst" targetRef="Task_Hardware_Second"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareSecond_Test" sourceRef="Task_Hardware_Second" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterHardwareSecond"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareFirst_Merge" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterHardwareSecond" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_5" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOrderMerge" targetRef="Gateway_InitialError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInitialError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardware" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftware" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalHardware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalTest" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" targetRef="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalTestResult" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ComputerRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Computer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Acceptance" name="Acceptance of repair costs"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Computer" name="Bring in defective computer" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Start_CRS" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Accept repair costs" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Customer process starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BringComputer" name="Bring in defective computer" messageRef="Message_Computer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptCosts" name="Are the costs acceptable?" default="Flow_Customer_Reject">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Accept repair costs" messageRef="Message_Acceptance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Accepted" name="Repair accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Rejected" name="Computer taken home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_BringComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Reject" name="Not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Task_TakeComputerHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="End_Customer_Accepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_TakeComputerHome" targetRef="End_Customer_Rejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CRS" name="Defective computer received">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_1</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_2</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Repair costs accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageCatchDefinition_Acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_4</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Hardware_First" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_HardwareFirst</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareFirst_Test</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterHardwareFirst" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareFirst_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareFirst_Software</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Software_Second" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareFirst_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareSecond_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareSecond" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareSecond_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareFirst_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Software_First" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_SoftwareFirst</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareFirst" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Hardware_Second" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Hardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareSecond_Test</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterHardwareSecond" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareSecond_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareFirst_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_5</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InitialError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoInitialError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" name="Choose another repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InitialError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" name="Repair activity complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalTestResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalError" name="Is an error detected?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalTestResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoInitialError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalError</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_1" sourceRef="Start_CRS" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_SendCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_3" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_4" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_HardwareFirst" name="Hardware then software" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOrder" targetRef="Task_Hardware_First">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[repairOrder = 'hardwareFirst']]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareFirst_Test" sourceRef="Task_Hardware_First" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterHardwareFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareFirst_Software" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterHardwareFirst" targetRef="Task_Software_Second"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareSecond_Test" sourceRef="Task_Software_Second" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareSecond"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareFirst_Merge" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareSecond" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_SoftwareFirst" name="Software then hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOrder" targetRef="Task_Software_First">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[repairOrder = 'softwareFirst']]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareFirst_Test" sourceRef="Task_Software_First" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareFirst_Hardware" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftwareFirst" targetRef="Task_Hardware_Second"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareSecond_Test" sourceRef="Task_Hardware_Second" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterHardwareSecond"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareFirst_Merge" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterHardwareSecond" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_5" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOrderMerge" targetRef="Gateway_InitialError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInitialError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardware" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalHardware">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[repairActivity = 'hardware']]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftware" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[repairActivity = 'software']]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalHardware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalTest" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" targetRef="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalTestResult" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ComputerRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Computer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairDecision" name="Customer repair decision"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Computer" name="Bring in defective computer" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Start_CRS" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AcceptDecision" name="Send repair decision" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RejectDecision" name="Send repair decision" sourceRef="Task_SendRejectDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Customer process starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BringComputer" name="Bring in defective computer" messageRef="Message_Computer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptCosts" name="Are the costs acceptable?" default="Flow_Customer_Reject">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptDecision" name="Send acceptance of repair costs" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejectDecision" name="Send rejection of repair costs" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Accepted" name="Repair accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Rejected" name="Computer taken home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_BringComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Accept" name="Acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptDecision">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[costsAcceptable]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Reject" name="Not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Task_TakeComputerHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptDecision" targetRef="End_Customer_Accepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_TakeComputerHome" targetRef="Task_SendRejectDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_SendRejectDecision" targetRef="End_Customer_Rejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CRS" name="Defective computer received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageStartDefinition_Computer" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive customer repair decision" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CRS_Decision" name="Are the costs acceptable?" default="Flow_CRS_Reject">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CRS_Unrepaired" name="Repair not undertaken">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Perform both repair activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_Software</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Hardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_Hardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterHardware" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Software" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterSoftware" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Both repair activities tested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialError" name="Is an error detected?" default="Flow_NoInitialError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InitialError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoInitialError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" name="Choose another repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InitialError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" name="Repair activity complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalTestResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalError" name="Is an error detected?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalTestResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoInitialError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalError</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_1" sourceRef="Start_CRS" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_SendCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_3" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CRS_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Accept" name="Acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_Decision" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[costsAcceptable]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Reject" name="Not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_Decision" targetRef="End_CRS_Unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_Hardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_Hardware" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Join" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Software" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_Software"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Test" sourceRef="Task_Software" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Join" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_5" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InitialError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInitialError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardware" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftware" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalHardware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalTest" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" targetRef="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalTestResult" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ComputerRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairDecision" name="Customer repair decision"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RejectDecision" name="Send repair decision" sourceRef="Task_SendRejectDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Customer process starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_StartToBring</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BringComputer" name="Bring in defective computer" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_StartToBring</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_BringToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_BringToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_ReceiveToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Customer_CostDecision" name="Are the costs acceptable?" default="Flow_Customer_Reject">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_ReceiveToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptDecision" name="Send acceptance of repair costs" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_AcceptToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejectDecision" name="Send rejection of repair costs" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_HomeToSendReject</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_RejectToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Accepted" name="Repair accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_AcceptToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Rejected" name="Computer taken home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_RejectToEnd</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_StartToBring" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_BringComputer"/>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_CheckToSendCalculation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_CheckToSendCalculation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_SendToReceiveDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive customer repair decision" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_SendToReceiveDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_ReceiveToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CRS_CostDecision" name="Route customer repair decision" default="Flow_CRS_Reject">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_ReceiveToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CRS_Unrepaired" name="Repair not undertaken">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Perform both repair activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_Software</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Hardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_Hardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareToTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterHardware" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareToTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Software" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareToTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterSoftware" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareToTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Both repair activities tested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToErrorDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialError" name="Is an error detected?" default="Flow_NoInitialError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToErrorDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InitialError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoInitialError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" name="Choose another repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InitialError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalHardwareToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalSoftwareToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" name="Merge alternative repair activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalHardwareToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalSoftwareToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalJoinToTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalJoinToTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalTestToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalError" name="Is an error detected?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalTestToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoInitialError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalError</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_StartToCheck" sourceRef="Start_CRS" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_CheckToSendCalculation" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_SendCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_SendToReceiveDecision" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_ReceiveToDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CRS_CostDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Accept" name="Acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_CostDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[costsAcceptable]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Reject" name="Not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_CostDecision" targetRef="End_CRS_Unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_Hardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareToTest" sourceRef="Task_Hardware" targetRef="Task_TestAfterHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Software" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_Software"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareToTest" sourceRef="Task_Software" targetRef="Task_TestAfterSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToErrorDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InitialError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInitialError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardware" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftware" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardwareToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalHardware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftwareToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalJoinToTest" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" targetRef="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalTestToDecision" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states that an actor performs an action that initiates the described process: Model the stated action as an activity in the actor’s scope; do not use a start event representing the resulting occurrence as a substitute for that activity. Represent the process start separately with an appropriate start event.
rules.situation: the description states that an actor performs an action that initiates the process

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity's object, scope, or alternative actions: Label the corresponding BPMN task concisely, preserving the stated action and distinctions without substituting a related action or adding unsupported meaning.
rules.situation: the description states an activity’s action, object, or scope

rules.instruction: When the description lists multiple required operations without specifying their order and states that a distinct follow-up occurs after each operation: Model the operations as required branches from a parallel split, with each follow-up on its corresponding branch.
rules.situation: the description lists multiple required operations without specifying their order and states that a distinct follow-up occurs after each operation

rules.instruction: Do not merge separately described actions into one task or split one stated action without a process reason. Preserve described dependencies.
rules.situation: the description presents multiple distinct actions together as one unit of work, and those actions are performed separately

rules.instruction: When the description states that a decision determines whether the process continues or an alternative outcome occurs: Model the decision with an exclusive gateway and provide a separate outgoing flow for each described outcome, connecting each flow to its corresponding next step.
rules.situation: the description states that a decision determines whether the process continues or an alternative outcome occurs
